items.content_html: SkinSpectra-X is a local research prototype for dermoscopic skin-lesion segmentation. It combines DINOv3 image features with RGB-derived pseudo-spectral estimates and evaluates segmentation, image quality, and uncertainty using public datasets. It is not a diagnostic tool; outputs require clinician review.
